dataset.validation_protocol: 5-fold expanding walk-forward chronological split with 1-hour (4-window) embargo; 1-contract exact Kalshi quadratic taker (0.07*p*(1-p)) and maker (0.0175*p*(1-p)) fees; 1,000x day-block bootstrap 95% CIs.

key_findings.why_optimal: Median bid-ask spread collapses 10x from 1.00c (Min 1–10) to 0.10c (Min 11–13), volume surges 2.2x, and Kalshi's quadratic taker fee drops 3–5x as prices disperse away from 50c.
key_findings.early_window_trap: Minutes 1–6 suffer ~1.0c spread + ~1.7c quadratic fee (2.2c+ total round-trip drag) while midpoint Brier is 0.175–0.231; crossing the ask early produces negative expected value across standard baselines.
key_findings.strongest_alpha_signal: Contemporaneous ETH+SOL 15m logit lead-lag divergence in Minutes 12–13 (+0.35% OOS Brier Skill Score over Kalshi midpoint with zero directional intercept), combined with passive maker limit orders to eliminate taker fee drag.
key_findings.honest_risk_note: Kalshi's BTC 15m midpoint is highly efficient after taker fees; disciplined PASS gating when net edge is below fee+spread hurdle prevents fee bleed. Past simulations do not guarantee future profits.
